role: Minimal institution-organization baseline for the current proprietary trading game: one governance layer, three investment operating departments and an administration shell.
invariants: the current institution is a proprietary trading firm with 10 million USD starting proprietary capital
institution_organization_v1 is the authoritative runtime owner of opening proprietary capital
global oil market-capacity binding is not expected at the initial 10 million USD scale and remains a diagnostic rather than a realism gate
external AUM, management-company economics, management fees, payroll and operating-company cash are not modeled in v0.2
Investment Decision is a governance layer, not an operating department
the current Investment Decision layer owns strategy capital authorization and registered strategy-mandate approval
the current single-strategy system proxy authorizes 100 percent of proprietary capital by default
capital authorization remains distinct from strategy risk limits, PM deployment preference and actual margin usage
the current single-strategy institution has no appointable corporate risk department or CRO seat
strategy-level position, drawdown, concentration, liquidity and roll rules remain enforceable without risk personnel
corporate portfolio risk code is retained dormant for a future multi-strategy or multi-asset portfolio
Investment Decision has no committee-member roster, voting model or personnel capability score in v0.2
Administration is the fourth named department and remains a shell only
Administration has no runtime logic, personnel capability model, payroll, recruiting, operating-cost or cash-flow model in v0.2
future multi-strategy allocation and administration mechanics must be added through new versioned contracts rather than inferred from this shell
